{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA rows again with exact string match
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA rows: {len(qa_rows)}')

# Also check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of revenue values with commas: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Show the first few
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values have commas and are not '999999.99'
comma_rows = df[has_commas & (df['revenue'] != '999999.99')]
print(f'Number of non-QA revenue values with commas: {len(comma_rows)}')

# Show those
print(comma_rows['revenue'].unique())"}
